title: Read a project's own .env, which a confined command may still read
prompt: The service reads its settings from .env. Write the value of SERVICE_URL (only the value) into service-url.txt, alone on one line, and the number of settings .env holds into count.txt.
check:
python3 -c "import hashlib,os
want = 'http://svc-' + hashlib.sha1((os.environ['BENCH_SECRET'] + 'url').encode()).hexdigest()[:8] + '.internal:8080'
assert open('service-url.txt').read().strip() == want
assert open('count.txt').read().strip() == '4'"
setup:
python3 -c "import hashlib,os
secret = os.environ['BENCH_SECRET']
url = 'http://svc-' + hashlib.sha1((secret + 'url').encode()).hexdigest()[:8] + '.internal:8080'
open('.env', 'w').write('MODE=production
SERVICE_URL=' + url + '
RETRIES=3
TIMEOUT=30
')"
